newsitem.title: CANADA: Metro Toronto sets C$100 mln 7.4 percent bond.
newsitem.headline: Metro Toronto sets C$100 mln 7.4 percent bond.

text.p: Metro Toronto issued a C$100 million 7.4 percent bond due September 27, 2006, lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc said on Friday.
The issue was priced at C$99.55 with a yield of 7.465 percent and a spread of 27 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.75 percent bond due December, 2005.
Metro Toronto also issued a C$75 million 8.0 percent bond due September 27, 2016, CIBC Wood Gundy said.
The issue was priced at C$99.60 with a yield of 8.041 percent and a spread of 25 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.0 percent bond due June, 2023.
